text:
izumi: Quick flag from silk-lite onboarding: ran rotate-kv + q6-low and seeing parentheses/bracket detachment for mixed CJK + RTL inputs. repro + numbers below.

tom: can you paste a tiny repro sample and git info?

izumi: commit b2f7c9a (kvcache:rotate-rollup), kernel v5.7.1, quant q6-low. short metric delta: baseline (flat-cache,q8) BLEU=30.6 -> rotate+q6 BLEU=22.2 on our 90-sample mixed set.

arya: that's a big regression. sample please.

izumi: example:```
# input: "我們走進 (אל)。"  # CJK + hebrew in parens
# baseline out: "We walked into (El)."
# experiment out: "We walked into )El(."
# notes: paren flipped and detached from hebrew fragment, spacing collapsed near CJK boundary.
```

buildbot: uploaded repro bundle -> gs://redwood-evals/silk-lite/6501234567_repro.zip (90 examples, detok script, token-diff.csv).

tom: can you run factor isolation A/B: 1) rotate only + q8, 2) flat + q6, 3) both combined?

izumi: did that already locally: rotate-only (q8) BLEU=28.8, quant-only (flat) BLEU=25.7, combined -> 22.2. so both factors contribute and interact nonlinearly.

quant-lab: quick triage notes: rotate changes prefix alignment and the fingerprint truncation leads to different kvcache hits; q6-low's reduced FP precision nudges softmax around punctuation tokens. together -> different top-k ordering and detok pairing breaks.

arya: immediate mitigation: add a heuristic to disable rotate-kv for prompts that contain both CJK and strong-RTL codepoints (simple Unicode class check) on canary. also add a targeted paired-punct regression (90-sample) to silk-lite onboarding smoke.

ops: canary toggle PR prepared: disable-rotate-mixed-orient (owner: izumi). will message Dedicated beta customers who enabled rotate.

quant-lab: long-term fixes: 1) include directional context bit and visible/invisible joiner bits in kvcache fingerprint, 2) add detok-preservation asserts to onboarding harness, 3) add a cross-factor fuzz that runs small quant variations with cache modes for every model bring-up.

tom: please open an issue with repro and attach the bucket. I'll also add an automated alert that fails onboarding if paired-punct-preserve drops >1% vs baseline.

izumi: opened R-INF-2401 and attached repro + eval logs. pinged @eng-runtime and @quant-team.

buildbot: canary-run: silk-lite v5.7.1-rotate-q6 -> queued (2 nodes)

arya: once canary shows regressions we should rollback rotate on canary and ship the heuristic. can we get a quick customer-facing note drafted? ops?

ops: will draft a short note for Dedicated customers and the beta channel. patch will be staged for canary rollback if metrics don't improve.

quant-lab: small follow-up: add unit that asserts bracket pairing preserved after detok for mixed-script lines, plus record token-id diffs around punctuation for triage. owner: tom.

izumi: thanks team. will follow up with PR link and timeline. :thumbsup:
